title: Base portraits: Mr. Mori, Mr. Hamada, the guard (no props)
question: Which base portrait for Mr. Mori, for Mr. Hamada and for the guard? Pick one per person; their expressions come after your pick.

media.caption: Mr. Mori: Eric, Mio, Kenji and Aoi as in the game, the portrait in the game now, then every attempt in order, framed on the game canvas at Kenji's face size. The tea cup in the current one is the prop. No "keep" option: the portrait in the game now holds a prop, so it breaks the no-props rule.

Mr. Hamada: Eric, Mio, Kenji and Aoi as in the game, the portrait in the game now, then every attempt in order, framed on the game canvas at Kenji's face size. The briefcase in the current one is the prop. No "keep" option: the portrait in the game now holds a prop, so it breaks the no-props rule.

The guard (Ishibashi): Eric, Mio, Kenji and Aoi as in the game, the portrait in the game now, then every attempt in order, framed on the game canvas at Kenji's face size. Only his hands and the clipboard change; head, face and glasses are the approved concept's own pixels. No "keep" option: the portrait in the game now holds a prop, so it breaks the no-props rule.
